keys.wouldClose: NOTHING at either zip, and this is stated plainly rather than softened. The LDA database is FEDERAL lobbying only — registrants, clients and the House and Senate offices they lobby. It has no county, municipal or school-district layer, and neither 07866 nor 03255 has a single owed Kelly field it could close. Where it WOULD earn its place is a later who-is-lobbying-my-delegation surface, which is not a hunt question.
